jobs.description:
Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 
Senior Production Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality of products and processes.  Works very closely with manufacturing and engineering to follow-up and improve processes to ensure a flawless transition into manufacturing and supplying of Li-Ion cells.  This role is the technical leader for specific processes, and is responsible for their performance and results, providing technical expertise and guidance to the team to reach targets assigned.   
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  
Lead quality assurance activities to ensure that production/product quality specifications are met.   
Lead and train quality team members and operations on quality standards and procedures.   
Perform onboarding, timesheets validation related to lead team members.   
Create Control plan and take part in FMEA analysis and facilitate continuous update of PFMEAs by working with multidisciplinary teams.   
Define and improve Work instructions and procedures for quality related activities.   
Monitor and analyse complex data with the help of statistical process control tools.   
Monitor and lead analysis of internal and external quality problems.   
Drive complex problem solving and root cause analysis.   
Drive quality improvement and optimization projects utilizing six sigma methodology.   
Transfer actions and lessons learned between products and production lines and integrate external lessons into preventive or corrective actions.   
Quality stakeholder in change management.   
Provide expert technology and quality knowledge of selected manufacturing processes.   
Define, improve, and validate results of the methods for MSA of the measurement equipment.  
Lead the team members on SPC, capability studies and quality process release and line release activities.   
Lead launch activities to ensure the deliverables of different projects.   
Report and mitigate safety relevant issues within the team in the appropriate system.   
Collaborate closely with Customer quality engineers to deliver required input to customer projects, e.g., PPAP documentation.   
Be part of equipment commissioning team and deliver acceptance testing and qualification milestones of new process equipment and installation of additional production lines. Quality stakeholder in process and product gate reviews.  

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No  
Direct reports: No  
Work environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively  supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
Qualifications and experience  
MSc or BSc degree in Chemical/Manufacturing/Engineering.   
6+ years of relevant work experience within high volume assembly/production, ideally in an operational role.   
Experience in Manufacturing quality in relevant industry. Experience in the battery/ automotive industry is a plus.   

Specific skills & Knowledge 
Leadership skills and a successful track record of leading quality improvement/six sigma projects in manufacturing and/or with suppliers.   
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.   
Knowledge of quality management systems, e.g., ISO 9001, IATF16949, TQM.   
Knowledgeable in SPC, process capability, FMEA, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology, Lean Six sigma and Statistics.

The opportunity
We’re Hiring: R&D Software Engineer | Hitachi Energy Do you want to develop software that helps power some of the world's most critical energy infrastructure? Join the MACH Infrastructure & Tools team at Hitachi Energy and work at the intersection of software engineering, industrial automation, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. You'll be part of a collaborative engineering team developing and evolving a strategically important in-house application used across our HVDC business. Unlike many corporate software roles, you'll have the opportunity to work across the complete software lifecycle and gain real ownership from day one.
This role offers the opportunity to work on software that directly supports critical infrastructure, contributing to solutions that have a real impact on the reliability and security of essential systems. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers and technical specialists, gaining valuable insights and hands-on experience in industrial digitalization, operational technology (OT) environments, networking, and cybersecurity.
Working in a quality-focused engineering environment, you'll leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to design and deliver innovative solutions. The position also provides excellent opportunities for professional growth, with potential career paths leading to roles such as Technical Lead, Product Owner, or Design Architect.
How you’ll make an impact 
Design, develop, test, and maintain industrial software applications using C#, .NET and Python technologies.
Collaborate with architects, project managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Support continuous improvement of software development processes, quality standards, and engineering practices
Contribute to reliability, cybersecurity, and long-term maintainability of software supporting critical infrastructure solutions.
Participate in technical investigations, troubleshooting activities, and feature development across the software lifecycle.
Build technical ownership of strategic applications and help drive future product and platform evolution.

Your background 
B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience with software development using C#, .NET and/or Python.
Knowledge of desktop application development; experience with MVVM architecture is considered an advantage.
Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to learn new technologies and domains.
Collaborative and self-driven personality with a high degree of ownership and accountability
Fluency in English, both written and spoken; Swedish is considered an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Product Development Senior Engineer – Situational Safety
jobs.description:
Autoliv is the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems. We develop, manufacture and market protective solutions such as airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for all major automotive manufacturers worldwide, along with advanced safety solutions for new mobility. In 2025, our products helped save approximately 40,000 lives and prevented around 600,000 serious injuries.
We are now looking for an experienced Product Development Senior Engineer to lead the development and execution of safety strategies for next-generation interior safety technologies. In this role, you will drive safety activities from concept through production release, working across engineering disciplines to deliver innovative solutions that help protect vehicle occupants worldwide. 
Role and Responsibilities

Define safety goals, hazard analyses, misuse scenarios, and mitigation strategies.

Lead the development and maintenance of safety cases, including claims, arguments, and supporting evidence.

Drive system architecture and safety decomposition for interior safety functions.

Establish safety milestones, release gates, and acceptance criteria.

Partner with Human Body Modeling & Simulation teams to translate insights into safety solutions.

Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, validation, human factors, and systems engineering.

Manage safety risks, escalations, audits, and customer assessments.

Align global requirements across Europe, North America, China, and Japan.

Support customer reviews and promote innovative interior safety technologies.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor's or master’s degree in engineering or a related field.

10+ years of experience in automotive safety, systems engineering, electronics, or mechatronics.

Strong knowledge of vehicle passive safety regulations and industry standards, including ISO 26262 and NCAP.

Deep understanding of occupant protection, safety mechanisms, and system-level design.

Proven track record of delivering safety cases and leading release governance in production programs.

Ability to actively contribute to and lead technical workshops and decision-making forums.

Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global engineering environment.

Strong documentation and presentation skills.

Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Who Are You?
You are a strategic leader with strong technical expertise and the ability to build alignment across teams and stakeholders. 
You bring:

Strong leadership and coordination capabilities.

Sound judgment and a high sense of ownership.

Excellent relationship-building and collaboration skills.

A strategic and results-oriented mindset.

Strong negotiation and influencing capabilities.

The ability to prioritize effectively and manage competing demands.

High emotional intelligence and the ability to handle conflict constructively. 

Why Autoliv?
At Autoliv, our purpose is simple: Saving More Lives. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to influence the next generation of safety innovations while working alongside some of the industry's most talented experts. Together, we develop technologies that make a real difference for people around the world. 
We would love to hear more about your experience, ambitions, and what inspires you. Let's start the conversation.

jobs.occupation: Senior Maintenance Technician – Mechanical & Cooling Systems
jobs.description:
Own thermal stability and mechanical reliability in a scaling deep-tech factoryOwn Thermal Stability and Mechanical Reliability
At Smart High Tech, we are industrialising advanced graphene-based materials that enable next-generation AI systems, electronics and data centres.
As we scale production, thermal performance and equipment reliability become critical for quality, uptime and efficiency.
We are now looking for a Senior Maintenance Technician – Mechanical & Cooling Systems who will take ownership of this important area and help ensure stable, reliable and scalable production.
Your Mission
You will be the technical expert for mechanical systems and cooling infrastructure, ensuring high equipment availability, efficient operation and long-term reliability.
Your work directly impacts production stability, energy efficiency and product quality.
What You Will DoMaintenance & Reliability
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on mechanical equipment, furnaces and cooling systems.

Troubleshoot hydraulic, pneumatic and thermal systems.

Lead fault diagnosis related to cooling, temperature control and process stability.

Monitor temperature, pressure and flow systems.

Prevent and manage risks related to overheating, leakage and reduced cooling performance.

Maintain technical documentation and maintenance records.

Continuous Improvement
Drive root cause analysis and long-term corrective actions.

Apply preventive and predictive maintenance methods.

Improve equipment reliability, uptime and energy efficiency.

Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.

Support and mentor colleagues within the maintenance organisation.

Equipment & Industrialisation
Participate in the installation and commissioning of new production equipment.

Support FAT and SAT activities.

Validate cooling systems, thermal processes and mechanical functionality.

Ensure systems are operational before production start-up.

Key Interfaces
You will work closely with:

Facility & Maintenance Manager

Electrical & Automation Maintenance

Production & Engineering

External suppliers and equipment vendors

Who You Are
You are a hands-on technical specialist with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for operational reliability.
Required Qualifications
Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Technology or similar.

F-Gas certification or equivalent refrigeration qualification.

Strong knowledge of hydraulics, pneumatics and cooling systems.

Minimum 5 years of industrial maintenance experience.

Experience with thermal processes and industrial cooling equipment.

Knowledge of CMMS systems and structured maintenance practices.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience with reliability-centred or predictive maintenance.

Experience from semiconductor, electronics, advanced materials or process industries.

Knowledge of FAT, SAT and equipment commissioning.

Training in LOTO, pressurised systems and industrial safety standards.

Swedish language skills.

Why Join Smart High Tech?
This is a role for someone who wants technical ownership in a high-performance manufacturing environment.
You will:

Own systems that directly impact product quality and production stability.

Work with advanced thermal and mechanical technologies.

Help scale a deep-tech factory from development to global production.

Influence uptime, efficiency and long-term operational performance.

Join a company solving real challenges in AI infrastructure and advanced electronics.

What Success Looks Like
Within 12 months, you have:

Improved cooling system reliability and production uptime.

Reduced equipment failures and unplanned downtime.

Increased energy efficiency and equipment lifetime.

Successfully supported commissioning of new production systems.

jobs.occupation: HMI Engineer to global company in Ludvika!
jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading actor within their domain, strongly believe in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
As an HMI Engineer, you will play an important role in designing, developing and implementing Human-Machine Interface (HMI) solutions for HVDC control systems. Your focus will be on creating user-friendly, efficient and reliable interfaces that meet technical requirements and quality standards.
You will work closely with engineers and technicians across different disciplines to ensure seamless integration of HMI solutions into larger control systems. Your responsibilities will cover several stages of the development process, including design, system integration, testing, troubleshooting and technical documentation.
You will also contribute your technical expertise to project activities and support the planning and follow-up of project schedules and budgets.
Responsibilities:
Design and develop user-friendly HMI solutions for HVDC control systems

Integrate HMI solutions into larger technical systems

Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to optimise system functionality

Test and troubleshoot HMI systems to ensure performance and reliability

Identify and resolve technical issues and software bugs

Prepare technical documentation, user manuals and specifications

Participate in project meetings and contribute technical expertise

Support project planning and follow-up of schedules and budgets

Who are you?
We are looking for someone with a genuine interest in technology and a strong willingness to learn and develop professionally. You approach technical challenges with curiosity, analytical thinking and a solution-oriented mindset.
You are structured, thorough and attentive to detail, with a natural focus on quality. You feel comfortable taking responsibility for your own work while also enjoying collaboration and knowledge-sharing with colleagues. Furthermore, you communicate effectively and thrive in an environment where different technical disciplines work towards common goals.
We are looking for someone who:
Holds a bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a related field

Has several years of work experience in software engineering, HMI development, industrial automation or a related technical field

Has programming knowledge and experience working with SCADA systems

Has good communication skills English, both written and spoken

It is considered an advantage if you have good communication skills in Swedish
Practical information
Location: Ludvika
Start: According to agreement
Working hours: Full-time, weekdays during daytime
Employment: You will work as a consultant through A-hub for 12 months, with the ambition of transitioning to direct employment with our client thereafter
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.
By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

Put your process expertise to work at Björkdalsgruvan. Solve technical challenges and turn your ideas into real improvement.
At Björkdalsgruvan, just outside Skellefteå, you will take on a varied and independent role as a Process Engineer, combining process analysis with technical improvements in the mineral processing plant. Working closely with operations, you will lead development projects aimed at improving and optimising production. You will also play an active role in modernising the plant, including enhancing process control and automation. You will be part of a flat organisation with short decision-making processes, a high degree of responsibility and real opportunities to make an impact.We are looking for someone with solid experience in process engineering, preferably from the mining industry, ore processing or mineral processing. We look forward to receiving your application!
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
An international and collaborative work environment where people, safety, hands-on problem-solving and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.
Swedish language lessons available if needed.
A flexible and stimulating work environment with competitive employment conditions and benefits, including a wellness allowance and a healthcare fund.
Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of annual leave.

Your Responsibilities
As a Process Engineer, you will provide technical support to the Processing Plant Manager and Operations Managers responsible for the processing plant and crushing operations. You will be responsible for ongoing process monitoring and lead improvement projects from investigation and planning through to implementation and follow-up.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Collecting and analysing process data, identifying deviations and optimising processes to ensure stable operations and improved gold recovery.
Investigating technical challenges related to flotation, grinding and reagent dosing.
Performing process engineering calculations and metal accounting.
Working with process flow diagrams, technical drawings and P&IDs as part of improvement projects.
Conducting laboratory-based process development and testing.
Collaborating with operations and maintenance teams on troubleshooting, planning and scheduled maintenance shutdowns.
Providing technical support to the processing plant, crushing operations and tailings facilities.
Participating in budgeting activities and contributing to systematic health, safety and work environment improvements.

The Bigger Picture
Your workplace will be the mineral processing plant at Björkdalsgruvan. This is a daytime position with flexible working hours based on trust and individual responsibility.
The plant uses ABB control systems, along with various systems for process monitoring and maintenance management. One of the current development priorities is reagent dosing, with the aim of automating process control to achieve a more stable, consistent and efficient operation.
Our Expectations
To succeed in this role, you will need:
A relevant university degree in Process Engineering, Mineral Processing, Chemical Engineering or a related field.
A good understanding of the relationship between chemistry, engineering and industrial processes.
Experience in technical problem-solving and process improvement.
The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, process flow diagrams and P&IDs.
The ability to work independently and turn analysis into practical, actionable solutions.
The ability to communicate effectively in English in a professional environment.

It would be particularly advantageous if you have:
Experience from the mining industry or mineral processing plants.
Knowledge of mineral processing operations, such as flotation and grinding.
Experience in technical improvement projects and industrial control systems.
Swedish language skills.

Interested?

The Opportunity
Join Hitachi Energy as a Transport & Logistics Specialist and play a key role in managing the entire end-to-end purchasing process.
At this position you will be responsible for requirements’ definition, preferred supplier selection, negotiation, and contracting. You will set the budget both in Tender and in Project Execution as well as shipping Heavy-Lift equipment globally. You will act as the main interface between internal stakeholders, customers, and freight forwarders. You’ll work in line with established quality, safety, and compliance standards, ensuring everything you do meets both internal guidelines and legal requirements.
How you’ll make an impact:
Act as Project Manager for Transport, Trade, and Logistics, ensuring adherence to KPIs for safety, quality, cost, delivery, innovation, and sustainability.
Proactively support project and logistics planners, and address transport challenges with suppliers.
Develop, plan, and implement Transport and Logistics strategy focusing on creating E2E transport budgets as input for tenders, optimizing transport portfolio, costs, quality and minimizing the risks.
Oversee transportation logistics for worldwide projects, including feasibility, budgeting, planning, sourcing, contracting, and negotiation, while also evaluating road surveys, storage areas, port capacities, and technical solutions for efficient lashing and lifting plans.
Investigate and improve transport quality and drive continuous improvement projects to mitigate them.
Collaborate cross-functionally to mitigate risk, support HVDC site design, and interact with stakeholders tender and project execution.
Ensure shipping compliance with all local and Global Regulations, project timelines and transportation budget.

Your background
Proven experience and background in Heavy‑Lift transport and sourcing, site operations and shipping, with hands‑on responsibility for cargos exceeding 200 tons.
Experience delivering large, complex projects end-to-end, from tendering and planning through execution and final delivery, is an advantage.
Curiosity and sense of ownership, with the confidence to challenge yourself and improve existing ways of working.
Energetic, motivated and self-confident team player with communicative and collaborative skills, with experience in multicultural and challenging global business environments.
Very good administration skills, as well as strong analytical and organizational skills, even under stress and pressure.
Very good analytical and problem solving skills, able to manage multiple priorities in parallel and perform effectively in ambiguous environments.
Fluent in English is required.

Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development

jobs.occupation: Offer Manager, Global Services Consulting & Training
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Offer Manager to lead and develop our Consulting and Training Services portfolio within Global Services for Nordic & Baltics. 
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our consulting and training offerings remain competitive, relevant, and aligned with customer needs, market trends, and business priorities. You will drive offer development and growth initiatives while working closely with sales teams, consultants, trainers, business units, and global stakeholders. 
The role plays a critical part in growing consulting revenue, supporting customer success, strengthening service differentiation, and unlocking additional business opportunities across segments. 
Your Mission 
As Offer Manager, your mission is to own and continuously develop the Consulting and Training Services offer portfolio. 
You will identify market opportunities, define value propositions, support go-to-market activities, and ensure our services address customer challenges while contributing to profitable business growth. 
You will act as the key interface between customers, sales teams, consultants, trainers, and global service organizations to ensure that our offers remain relevant, scalable, and commercially successful. 
Key Responsibilities 
Own and develop the Consulting and Training Services portfolio across targeted markets and customer segments. 
Drive offer strategy, positioning, and value propositions for consulting and training services. 
Identify customer needs, market trends, and growth opportunities to strengthen the service offering. 
Support sales teams with service knowledge, customer value messaging, and sales enablement materials. 
Collaborate with consultants, trainers, sales teams, and business leaders to ensure service offerings meet customer expectations and business objectives. 
Monitor offer performance, including revenue growth, utilization trends, customer demand, and business impact. 
Gather market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitive insights to support continuous improvement of the portfolio. 
Drive awareness and adoption of consulting and training services internally and externally. 
Support strategic customer engagements and service development initiatives. 
Partner with global and regional stakeholders to align service offerings with broader business strategies. 
Work closely with the local training center to optimize and enhance the Services Training catalog 
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, marketing campaigns, and sales enablement materials to increase offer visibility, generate demand, and drive business growth 
Develop, manage, and optimize pricing strategies to ensure market competitiveness, profitability, and alignment with business objectives. 

 
What We Are Looking For 
Experience in Offer Management, Service Portfolio Management, Product Marketing, Business Development, Consulting, or a related commercial role. 
Strong understanding of consulting services, technical services, training services, or service-based business models. 
Experience working closely with sales organizations and cross-functional stakeholders. 
Ability to translate customer needs into clear service offerings and business opportunities. 
Strong commercial mindset with the ability to drive growth and service adoption. 
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
Experience working in international and matrix organizations is an advantage. 
Full professional proficiency in English 

What Makes You Successful 
You are customer-focused, commercially driven, and comfortable taking ownership of a service portfolio. 
You combine strategic thinking with practical execution and can translate customer and market insights into service offerings that create value for customers and drive business growth. 
You enjoy working across functions, influencing stakeholders, and building strong relationships while ensuring service offerings remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with business priorities. 
Did we get you inspired?
Join Schneider Electric and unlock your full potential! Apply now and embark on an exciting career journey with us.

 You will bring

jobs.occupation: Technical Responsible Automation and OT Systems Finishing
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about automation engineering and curious about complex converting machine technologies?
As part of Tetra Pak Development & Technology organisation, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining and implementing world class converting solutions, enabling Tetra Pak to deliver competitive packaging solutions.
We are currently looking for a Technical Responsible within Automation Finishing, where finishing represents the last process step in production of packaging material. In this position you will lead and supervise specific high complex Automation design activities, related to D&T Converting solutions equipment's. You will act as mentor and coach for other Automation Engineers, give support and guidance to other colleagues and suppliers in the area as well as participating in strategy and roadmap work.
This is a permanent position based in Lund, Sweden.
What you will do
As our Technical Responsible, you will have the technical responsibility for the automation and OT solutions in Finishing, including Life Cycle Management. You will plan, conduct and supervise assignments, review progress and evaluate results. You will belong to a network of Technical Responsible Automation and OT systems (TRA/TRO) from other equipment areas. In addition, you will ensure stable integration, operation, support, development and continuous improvement of Operational Technology (OT) systems within the Finishing area. You will participate in portfolio analysis together with System Engineers and Architects and act as the bridge between equipment teams and IT/OT development teams.
Other responsibilities:
Drive the development, support, and continuous improvement of Automation and OT solutions.
Act as the interface between equipment teams, IT/OT development teams, System Engineers, and Architects.
Monitor system performance, manage incidents, and ensure reliable operation and availability.
Lead and prioritize lifecycle management, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure data flow integrity and data quality across connected systems.
Provide technical support to factories and share knowledge through mentoring and coaching.
Develop and maintain technical documentation in compliance with company standards and legal requirements.
Plan, estimate, and coordinate automation projects and technical activities.
Conduct and follow up technical reviews with internal stakeholders, factories, and suppliers.
Collaborate with Technical Responsible across other equipment areas to align standards and best practices.

Who you are
We believe that you have a solid background with more than 4 years of relevant work experience in automation. You have extensive knowledge and understanding of Automation solutions generally with Siemens's systems. Experience in Finishing and/or knowledge within Motion systems is considered an advantage and you have an understanding of Industrial IT and Operational Technology.
You have personal drive with a clear focus on delivering results with quality. You also understand how to lead and motivate people, having the ability to adjust your leadership to different situations. As Tetra Pak for sure is a global company, you communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.
We offer you
Variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
Culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our engineering experts drives visible results
Equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.
Objective of the position
Help us build the test systems behind safer, smarter vehicles.
At Stoneridge in Örebro, our Production Engineering team makes sure every product that leaves the line performs exactly as it should. As our new Test Engineer, you'll own the test solutions for new product introductions — designing them from the ground up — and continuously sharpen the tests already running in production. Your work directly shapes the quality, reliability and efficiency of technologies that go into commercial vehicles around the world.
You'll report to the Production Engineering Manager and work alongside a hands-on, cross-functional team that values curiosity and ownership.
What you'll do

Design and build production test software, methods and equipment for both new products and existing lines.

Specify, procure, install and validate new test systems — and keep current ones running at their best.

Be the go-to expert for production teams when test challenges, product changes or process changes come up.

Build and evaluate prototypes, giving the development team clear feedback to improve quality and manufacturability.

Own the documentation — test procedures, verification and training that keep knowledge in the team.

Drive the numbers that matter: test yield, downtime and PPM, and support quotations and approval workflows.

What you bring

BSc/MSc in Electronics (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years in test engineering, production or industrialization — automotive preferred.

Strong electronics fundamentals — you can read and create electrical schematics.

Experience with vision systems (Cognex VisionPro, AVT or similar).

Proficiency in graphical programming tools such as LabVIEW or Keysight VEE.

Solid grasp of statistics (Cpk, standard deviation); Six Sigma Green Belt is an advantage.

Professional level of Swedish and English.

Bonus skills: Minitab, C# and CAN protocols.

What we offer
You will be welcomed to a Fun, Diverse and Inclusive workplace, where we base our culture on our Core Values: Integrity, Customer orientation, Teamwork, Adaptability, Accountability and Social responsibility. This role is a central role in shaping the future within a multinational automotive technology company focusing on safety and security. We also offer you an opportunity for personal and professional growth in a fast‑growing, constantly evolving organization with competitive salary based on knowledge and experience.
Interested? Please apply to this position using the above link.
